title: View — section planes
description: A row of sphere-on-cube pairs sliced by two section planes (one horizontal, one diagonal). Sliders move each plane along its normal; the toggle buttons activate / deactivate. The renderer packs every active plane into a fixed-size uniform `vec4[8]` bank and the fragment shader walks `uSectionPlaneCount` of them per fragment — so creating, destroying, or toggling planes never recompiles the shader, and scenes with no active planes pay one int compare per fragment for the whole feature.
